Distance between the members of a scale

Source: R/distance.R
scale_distance.Rd

This feature may change or be removed in a later version.

Reshapes long, member-keyed data into a member-by-observation matrix and measures the distance between its rows.

Usage

scale_distance(
  data,
  x,
  frame = NULL,
  key = NULL,
  value = NULL,
  method = "euclidean",
  scale_members = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

Long data: a column of member codes, one or more identifier columns saying which observation each row is, and a value column.

x

A NestedScale.

frame

Frame whose members are compared. Defaults to the leaf frame.

key

Column of data holding the member codes. Defaults to frame when present, else the scale's leaf column.

value

Value column; inferred when unambiguous.

method

A name from list_scale_distances().

scale_members

Standardise each member's profile to mean 0, sd 1 before measuring. Turns a level distance into a shape distance; has no effect on "correlation", which already ignores level.

Value

A stats::dist object over the frame's members, in member order.

Examples

s <- scale_example()
d <- data.frame(
  item = rep(scale_members(s), each = 3),
  t = rep(sprintf("t%d", 1:3), 7), v = as.numeric(seq_len(21))
)
round(scale_distance(d, s, method = "correlation"), 2)
#>     U1 U2 U3 U4 U5 U6
#> U2   0               
#> U3   0  0            
#> U4   0  0  0         
#> U5   0  0  0  0      
#> U6   0  0  0  0  0   
#> OTH  0  0  0  0  0  0
